# anthropic_telemetry_destination_workspace (Resource)

Beta. Puts one workspace on a telemetry destination's workspace list (`/v1/organizations/telemetry_destinations/{destination_id}/workspaces`). With `workspace_scope = "include"` the workspace's spans go to the destination. With `exclude` they don't. Not supported when `workspace_scope` is `all`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "anthropic_telemetry_destination_workspace" "example" {
  destination_id = anthropic_telemetry_destination.collector.id
  workspace_id   = "wrkspc_01ABCDEF"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination_id` (String) ID of the telemetry destination (`tdst_...`).
- `workspace_id` (String) ID of the workspace (`wrkspc_...`).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the workspace was added to the list.
- `id` (String) Composite identifier in the format `<destination_id>/<workspace_id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <destination_id>/<workspace_id>
terraform import anthropic_telemetry_destination_workspace.example tdst_01ABCDEF/wrkspc_01ABCDEF
```
